column1: # PAYSUB roles: admin / quanly / giamdoc / nhanvien (PRD D19).
# admin is wildcard; the other three are enumerated.
# Quanly — the paying company's managers: daily operations surface
# Billing (FR-2/FR-3): quanly uploads transfer results and reads outcomes
# Giamdoc — director: duyệt công and the billing-report pipeline (D19)
# Nhanvien — read-only self-service (own profile; pay history endpoint lands with FR-6/A7)
# Ketoan — accounting clerk (PAYSUB D28): reads the same operational surfaces
# as giamdoc but holds no approval rights.
# Payment history (Lịch sử trả lương): bank-entry ledger + per-project Excel
# export — read-only; quanly / ketoan / giamdoc (admin wildcard covers admin).
